propositions: CLI-served author guides (plan, review) contain dangling consumer-relative path references that fail to resolve for clients without a rebar checkout
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no discoverable CLI home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help documents it
Packaged guides must repoint all cross-references to use either hosted GitHub URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/...) or rebar explain <topic> command invocations
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES and discoverable via rebar explain commit-trailer and the MCP explain_criterion tool
A comprehensive link-resolution guard test must enforce that no packaged guide or CLI-served prose contains consumer-relative paths (only https://, http://, #anchor, or mailto: targets allowed)
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring and test assertions must confirm all AUTHOR_GUIDES topics are discoverable and listed
